quote.text: Everything is connected to everything else.
quote.author: Barry Commoner, The Closing Circle, 1971 — the first of his four laws of ecology

stories.headline: Paris curfews Place de la République after 550,000 marched and 2,400 were arrested
stories.dek: Macron refused Laurent Nuñez’s offer to resign on Monday. Almost 1,000 police were hurt on Saturday, seven seriously, and the 140-year-old Limoges town hall was largely destroyed.

stories.headline: Kostal charges $18,000 for a Brazilian back and $550 for an Adirondack top
stories.dek: A 2018 paper in the Journal of the Acoustical Society of America built six guitars identical but for the back wood. Thirty-one players in welder’s goggles could not tell them apart.

stories.headline: Bespoked brings the handmade-bicycle show to Osaka on Friday with 70-plus makers
stories.dek: It is the show’s first Asian edition, three days from now, six and a half hours from Changi. Advance tickets close on Thursday 22 October.

stories.headline: Singapore’s National Wages Council recommends 6 to 8% for workers under S$2,800
stories.dek: The Government accepted the guidelines on Monday 19 October. NTUC calls it the highest range since 2021; Mothership reports that barely a quarter of employers met last year’s.

stories.headline: Beijing made dredger and drone export controls law; the AI list stays a draft
stories.dek: MOFCOM’s 16 October announcement proposed 40 technologies, 23 of them AI, and takes comment until 15 November. Monday’s batch is effective 18 November.

stories.headline: Engadget scored the Even Realities G2 at 6.9 and preferred the older G1
stories.dek: Daniel Cooper’s review ran on 19 October. Even charges Singapore US$649 for the same glasses it sells Americans at US$599, and bills in US dollars.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · IWC’s Lunar New Year
stories.headline: IWC limits its Year of the Goat chronograph to 500 pieces at CHF 10,400
stories.dek: Announced in Schaffhausen on 15 October, four months before the year it marks begins on 6 February 2027. The movement is built by ValFleurier, not in Schaffhausen.

stories.headline: Neon opened William Greaves’s 1972 Harlem film on two screens at $34,153 each
stories.dek: Shot on 16mm at Duke Ellington’s Harlem home in August 1972 and finished by his son David, it holds 100 per cent from 55 critics and a Metascore of 93.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · The First Phone
stories.headline: A study in Frontiers tracked 3,486 children through their first smartphone year
stories.dek: Published 30 September in Frontiers in Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, it found tripled odds of a social media account and school-night sleep down a fifth of a standard deviation.

stories.headline: American energy prices rose 20.4% to September while the Fed kept raising
stories.dek: Global equities and global bonds both fell on Monday 19 October as all three Treasury yields rose. The 2s10s curve steepened back to 38 basis points.

stories.headline: The ETHOS study priced one MET of fitness at 16 per cent of mortality
stories.dek: Published on 6 October in Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise, it reports ten-year mortality of 32.9 per cent in the unfit against 13.4 in the fit.

stories.headline: Bespoked opens in Osaka on Friday and advance tickets close on Thursday
stories.dek: The handmade-bicycle show’s first Asian edition runs 23–25 October with 70-plus makers. Tokyo Marathon volunteer entry opens 4 November and closes on the 15th.

stories.headline: Pre-sale cancellations in Taiwan reached 3,457 in seven months, up 81 per cent
stories.dek: Pre-sale transactions fell 73 per cent in 2025 and Taiwan’s unsold inventory hit a record 332,000 units — while the central bank spent September loosening the clamp.
